intro.prompt: Professional audio mastering, sound waves, music production studio, technology

scenes.voiceover: Welcome to Echo Sound Lab. AI-powered audio mastering for professional results.
The Echo Sound Lab logo takes you back to the main workspace.
Upload your audio file to begin the mastering process.
Echo Sound Lab analyzes your track in real-time, extracting metrics and identifying areas for improvement.
Switch to AI Studio mode for intelligent, guided mastering suggestions.
Multi-stem mode lets you work with individual tracks for precise control.
Video Engine generates AI-powered visuals synced to your audio.
Return to Single mode for streamlined stereo mastering.
View your complete processing history to compare and revert changes.
Access settings to configure your workflow and preferences.
Scroll through the analysis panel to review spectral data, LUFS, and dynamic range.
Every action is governed by Action Authority, ensuring transparent, auditable processing.
Echo Sound Lab. Professional mastering powered by AI. Your sound, perfected.
